newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market trade at holiday standstill.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market trade at holiday standstill.

text.p: There was no trade on the Croatian money market on Thursday and dealers said they expected the banks to remain inactive until next week.
As the banks enjoyed good liquidity just before the end-of-year holidays no deals were struck in overnight trade on New Year's Eve.
They also placed 271 million kuna in central bank bills at Tuesday's auction. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
